<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-adapters.mjs — do not edit manually. -->
Follow `standards/design-system.md` and `standards/frontend.md`:

- Use CSS custom-property tokens for palette, typography, spacing, borders, radii, and reduced-motion rules. Reject default purple gradients, glassmorphism, and fake testimonials/metrics.
- Keep initial data loading in Server Components (no client mount waterfalls) and mirror list filters/search/sort/pagination in URL `searchParams`.
- Implement all 7 UI states (`loading`, `empty`, `error`, `success`, `disabled`, `focus-visible`, `long content`), accessible form labels/live alerts, and keyboard focus trapping in modals/drawers.
- Verify rendered screenshots at `360px`, `768px`, and `1440px` plus `@axe-core/playwright` (remembering `axe` alone is not full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance).
